label: RB922UAGS-5HPacD
description: MikroTik RB922UAGS-5HPacD (RB922UAGS-5HPacD) — 1x 1G RJ45, 1x SFP, Wi-Fi 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9557.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (8-30 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 17 W.
